Maybe the position is a stalemate trap: White king on c1 might be in stalemate if black moves correctly. Let's see white king moves. After black move, white must have a legal move. If black can move to stalemate white, that's good.

White king moves: b1,b2,c2,d1 (d2 occupied). Also maybe? c1 to... e1? No.
